item.title: Iran will never accept diplomacy based on coercion, blackmail, says foreign ministry spokesperson
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran will never accept diplomacy based on coercion, blackmail or the imposition of unilateral demands, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said, stressing that Tehran regards diplomacy, alongside defensive capabilities, as an essential instrument for safeguarding its national interests.

Tehran, IRNA – Iran will never accept diplomacy based on coercion, blackmail or the imposition of unilateral demands, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said, stressing that Tehran regards diplomacy, alongside defensive capabilities, as an essential instrument for safeguarding its national interests.

item.title: In photos: Iran’s Kurdistan honors child and teenage martyrs
item.description: The following images show a ceremony honoring 306 child and teenage martyrs from the western province of Kurdistan, which took place in Sanandaj, the capital of the province, on November 3, 2026. The event also paid tribute to the children killed in the Shajareh Tayyebeh school attack in Minab and Palestinian children martyred in Gaza.
